dish.description: Browned Japanese eggplant and wilted Thai basil over jasmine rice, seasoned with soy sauce and garlic.

recipe_version.title: Thai Basil Eggplant Stir-Fry
recipe_version.description: Browned Japanese eggplant and wilted Thai basil over jasmine rice, seasoned with soy sauce and garlic.
recipe_version.doneness: Eggplant browned and tender, center creamy with no raw white spongy core. Basil wilted, not blackened. Rice tender.

substitutions.soy sauce: Keep wheat-containing soy sauce. Wheat-free tamari would drop the wheat allergen and is not this version.
substitutions.fish sauce: Do not substitute fish sauce. It would drop the plant claim and add finfish.

ingredients.name: Japanese eggplant
ingredients.note: sliced 1/2 inch thick on the diagonal

ingredients.name: soy sauce
ingredients.note: standard wheat-containing soy sauce, not tamari and not fish sauce

ingredients.name: neutral oil
ingredients.note: grapeseed or canola, not sesame oil; 2 tbsp to brown the eggplant, 1 tbsp to bloom the garlic

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: in the rice only; Diamond Crystal. If Morton, use 1/4 tsp. The stir-fry is salted by the soy sauce.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Rinse the jasmine rice. Bring it to a boil with the water and the kosher salt. Cover, turn the heat to low, and simmer 15 minutes. Rest it covered off the heat 5 minutes, then fluff. The eggplant browns while this rice simmers and rests, including a second batch if the pan is crowded, so the rice does not have to finish before the skillet starts. This is the starch for all 4 servings. v1 said only for serving.

steps.title: Brown the eggplant
steps.body: While the rice simmers and rests, heat a wide skillet over high heat with 2 tbsp of the neutral oil. Add the Japanese eggplant in a single layer, in two batches if it would crowd. Stir-fry until browned and tender, 6-8 minutes per batch. The center of a piece should be creamy, with no raw white spongy core. Crowding will steam it instead of browning it.

steps.title: Season
steps.body: Add the remaining 1 tbsp neutral oil. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds, until fragrant. Do not add the garlic off the heat; v1 did, and it stays harsh. Add the soy sauce and toss to coat. Take the pan off the heat and stir in the Thai basil until just wilted. There is no chili, no curry paste, and no fish sauce in this version.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the eggplant and basil over the rice. Four servings.

projection.allergen_note: Soy and wheat come from standard soy sauce. Dietary eligibility is separate: plant and dairy-free. Gluten-free is not claimed.
